title: Fabulous activity!
text: We had a fabulous time doing this activity and went home with lovely headbands to wear to our flamenco dancing dinner that night, which we got many compliments for! The ladies were great fun, we were greeted with music, dancing, sparkling wine, and snacks and were provided the right mix of autonomy and help to make our creations. My husband even came along and enjoyed the process, donating his headband to another lady on our tour. Highly recommend this activity!
author: E3376FSrebeccac

title: Every single person in...
text: Every single person in this workshop was a delight! I attended with some coworkers and the hosts made us all feel comfortable and right at home! I can't say enough good things about  how they went out of their way to make this a memorable event! We got to pick our preferred flowers and other details, but the best thing was that we took home our creation.  I will totally recommend it to everyone that visits Seville
author: Belen_M

title: This workshop is not...
text: This workshop is not observing the artisans make the flower crowns as i thought, we got to properly craft and pick the crown style we wanted, we choose flowers, details and then we decorated it ourselves! Also, the vibe in the shop was awesome, as everyone loved the experience. It was really fun and interactive, but the best thing was having a physical product to take home. I would recommend this class and would do it again with others!
author: Rafa_S
